cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-narrow-heading-keeps-its-chips
cases.purpose: A heading keeps its keyword, priority and title at a narrow measure.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-footnotes-in-lists-share-one-sequence
cases.purpose: Footnote references inside list items share the document sequence.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-toc-skips-commented-sections
cases.purpose: A COMMENT section stays out of the table of contents and stays folded.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-file-title-drops-the-extension
cases.purpose: A document without a title names itself by its file, without the .org suffix.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-children-fold-leaves-subheadings-openable
cases.purpose: A section shown as children still lets its subheadings open.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-metadata-and-counts
cases.purpose: A document reports its title, outline, section count, status counts and degradation count through a state snapshot.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-outline-carries-keyword-priority-tags
cases.purpose: The outline exposes each headline's level, title, id, keyword and tags so navigation and tests see the same document model.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-create-requires-a-source
cases.purpose: Creating a session without a file or text signals `etaf-org-preview-error' instead of returning a half-built session.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-create-reports-a-missing-file
cases.purpose: An unreadable document names the missing path in the preview's own error type.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-refresh-rereads-the-file
cases.purpose: Refreshing a file session republishes the file's current heading and body, replacing the stale render.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-refresh-keeps-the-document-on-failure
cases.purpose: A failed refresh keeps the last good document published and signals the preview error.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-state-is-detached
cases.purpose: Mutating a state snapshot never changes the session, so callers can inspect and cache it safely.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-fold-hides-the-body
cases.purpose: Folding a section removes its body and every descendant body from the visible buffer while keeping the headline.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-fold-children-keeps-child-headlines
cases.purpose: The children fold state shows child headlines and hides both the parent body and the child bodies.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-overview-startup-shows-headlines-only
cases.purpose: Starting in the overview state renders every headline with no body, which is the cheap first paint for a large document.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-fold-all-updates-every-section
cases.purpose: A document-wide fold writes every section's cell and reports the same state for all of them.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-fold-unknown-section-errors
cases.purpose: An unknown section or fold state signals `etaf-org-preview-error' rather than silently doing nothing.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-fold-publishes-one-region
cases.purpose: Folding one section publishes a small buffer update, proving the document is not re-rendered as a whole.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-inline-emphasis-and-code-faces
cases.purpose: Bold, italic, underline, strike-through and verbatim spans render their own face attributes and drop their markers.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-entities-and-subscripts
cases.purpose: Org entities, subscripts and superscripts render as Unicode characters inside ordinary text.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-link-stays-in-the-paragraph
cases.purpose: A link renders inside its paragraph, so the text around it stays on one line instead of a block break.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-timestamp-renders-as-a-date
cases.purpose: An active timestamp renders as a date with the Chinese weekday and the time.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-planning-line-shows-both-dates
cases.purpose: SCHEDULED and DEADLINE render together on the planning line below the headline.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-checkbox-states-are-distinct
cases.purpose: Empty, done and in-progress checkboxes render three different marks.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-description-list-keeps-the-term
cases.purpose: A description list item renders its term and its description on one row.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-table-renders-every-cell
cases.purpose: A table renders its header row and every body cell.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-code-block-keeps-its-source
cases.purpose: A source block shows its language label and its body text.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-callouts-are-initialized-by-kind
cases.purpose: Warning and quote blocks render written labels and their content, not their uppercase block names.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-footnotes-are-numbered-and-listed
cases.purpose: A footnote reference is numbered and the footnote text is listed at the end of the document.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-comments-are-folded-initially
cases.purpose: A COMMENT headline starts folded, hides its body, and reveals it when the section is opened.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-unknown-block-counts-as-degraded
cases.purpose: An unclosed block keeps its text visible and is counted in the document's degradation count.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-missing-image-becomes-a-card
cases.purpose: A link to a missing image renders a placeholder card instead of signaling during render.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-theme-cycles-and-rejects-unknown
cases.purpose: Cycling selects the next fixed palette, an unknown palette signals the preview error, and a mounted document repaints.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-width-adjust-stays-in-range
cases.purpose: The reading measure clamps to the configured minimum and maximum.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-toc-toggle-hides-the-contents-card
cases.purpose: Hiding the table of contents removes the contents card from the mounted document.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-narrow-window-keeps-the-measure
cases.purpose: A narrow viewport still mounts and renders the document's headlines without signaling.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-locate-moves-to-the-heading
cases.purpose: Locating an outline entry moves point to that headline's row, so navigation and imenu use the mounted tree's own positions.

cases.name: etaf-org-preview-tests-heading-navigation-round-trips
cases.purpose: Next and previous heading move between headlines and return to the same row, so outline navigation never gets stuck on one heading.
